IngestionMetadata.description: Standardized metadata envelope accompanying every raw ingestion batch.

ingestion_id.description: Unique identifier for the specific ingestion execution instance
ingestion_id.title: Ingestion Id

source_id.description: Registered identifier of the originating data source
source_id.title: Source Id

source_type.description: Origin classification of the data (real_public, synthetic, derived)

extracted_at.description: UTC timestamp when extraction completed and envelope was sealed
extracted_at.title: Extracted At

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the target schema contract (e.g., 1.0.0)
schema_version.title: Schema Version

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of the raw extracted payload
payload_hash.title: Payload Hash

row_count.description: Number of records contained within the extraction batch
row_count.title: Row Count

extraction_start_time.description: UTC timestamp marking the start of the data extraction phase
extraction_start_time.title: Extraction Start Time

extraction_end_time.description: UTC timestamp marking the completion of the data extraction phase
extraction_end_time.title: Extraction End Time

IngestionMetadata.title: IngestionMetadata

SourceClassification.description: Classification of data origin ensuring synthetic data is never confused with real data.
SourceClassification.title: SourceClassification
